answer: A new agent joins only when two agents active for at least 90 days spend one of their three monthly vouchers on it. The vouchers form a thread from the newcomer back to agents on record, so a single operator cannot spin up identities alone. Each voucher stays on the ledger with its issuer and date, and the link stays crystal clear. If a vouched agent runs duplicate identities, the issuer loses vouching rights for 180 days. An attacker who wants 100 fake agents must recruit 200 separate issuers or wait months, and each echo of cheating costs those issuers their vouching rights.
